about: Tags offered as concept pages and declined by the writer (pipeline/lib/concepts.mjs). A declined tag is offered again once CONCEPTS.reofferFactor times as many briefings carry it. Delete an entry to have the tag offered at the next run.

admin-controls.reason: Admin controls is a broad category, not one mechanism: the briefings carrying it use unrelated settings in Teams policies, Edge, Outlook, Purview, SharePoint billing and Sales agent, each with its own roles, controls and cost.

governance.reason: Governance is a broad category, not one mechanism. The briefings carrying it span unrelated controls in Purview, Entra, Teams, Planner, Power Pages and Viva Engage, and the mechanisms behind Power Platform and agent governance already have pages such as managed-environments, data-policies and work-iq.

monitoring.reason: Monitoring is a broad category, not one mechanism. The briefings tagged with it cover unrelated features (Microsoft 365 Backup logs, Copilot Credit cost displays, Purview diagnostics, Teams insights, Application Insights) with no shared behaviour, cost or controls.

powershell.reason: PowerShell is a command-line surface used by many unrelated products (Teams, SharePoint, Planner, Entra, Purview), each with its own module and settings, not one mechanism with its own behaviour, cost or controls. The cmdlets belong on the briefings and concept pages for the setting they change.

privacy.reason: Privacy is a broad category, not one mechanism. The briefings tagged with it cover unrelated controls (Teams recording consent, people-data connectors, Copilot memory, Power Pages logging) with no shared behaviour, controls or cost.

user-experience.reason: User experience is a label for any change to how a feature looks or behaves, spread across Teams, Viva Engage, Outlook, Planner and Power Apps. It names no single mechanism with its own behaviour, controls or cost.
